remazu.title: ReMazu: Iterations of Devotion
description: Multimedia project ReMazu: Iterations of Devotion  chronicles the cyclical journeys of a deity named Mazu, a sea goddess and shaman who was first mythologized in Fujian in Southern China, later spreading to Taiwan, and Southeast Asia. Through research, writing and prototypiing, I reimagine Mazu as a contemporary queer deity, informed by the complexity of coastal diasporic identities, informed by a spiritual connection to the powers of water and a hunger for transformation.

Building and animating a digital avatar in digital-ambient environments, the process of virtual production became a body-centering experience. Reflecting on this process, the film uses iterative calling to frame Mazu as an emotional reprogramming loop. Driven by the intense desire to be seen/heard/felt/held, the act of inviting her triggers the process of remothering, to create the safety needed to shield from the vioelnt forces of colonialism and Confucianist hetero-patriarchy.
components: sculptures: 有求必应 (Your Desires Will be Answered)

sibuxiang.title: Sibuxiang: The Four Not-Likes
sibuxiang.summary: The Four Not-Likes (四不象) is an interactive performance centered around a hybrid quadruped creature whose movement is controlled through a custom physical interface.
description: The Four Not-Likes (四不象) takes its name from the Chinese mythological creature Sibuxiang, whose body appears to contain features of multiple animals while belonging fully to none. The project centers around a digitally modeled and animated quadruped creature inhabiting a virtual environment.

Built through a pipeline spanning 3D modeling, character animation, game-engine development and physical hardware, the work connects the creature's movement in Unity to a custom arcade-style controller. Through this relationship between bodily input, virtual movement and the hybrid creature, the project explores different ways of inhabiting and navigating a digital body.
credits: Developed at Design Media Art, UCLA

triadic-patterning.title: Triadic Patterning
triadic-patterning.summary: A Sequel to ReMazu: Iterations of Devotion
description: Triadic Patterning is a worldbuilding project that evolved across a three-channel video, interactive website, and 3D printed sculpture. It explores the triadic relationship between Qianliyan (Thousand-Mile Eye), Shunfeng’er (Wind-Following Ear), and Mazu. Qianliyan and Shunfeng’er are guardian deities embodying the act of seeing and listening, appearing in myth as anthropomorphic tools. In my reframing, Qianliyan and Shunfeng’er cause havoc due to their separation and unexamined pain; sensing this chaos, Mazu binds them together in a contract of Daoist magic, completing a triadic patterning of embodied integration.
exhibitions: DEMO2024: Random Access Memory, NEW INC, 2024
credits: Produced and developed at NEW INC, 2024
Special thanks to mentor Lauren Goshinsky

dong.title: DONG
dong.collaboration: Written by Banyi Huang and Maya Yu Zhang; Director: Maya Yu Zhang; Sound design: Lemon Guo, Mengtai Zhang, and FURTIVE; Visual effects: Eva Wo
description: Mixing fantasy, pornography, and horror, DONG 洞 takes place in a lunar cave, where a post-gender being embarks on an auto-erotic journey of an impossible return to the maternal. Upon encountering a ritual object in the form of a rabbit dildo, the mystical being taps into their libido to recall their past life as BuddhaThe film illuminates a joyous and disastrous path marked by diasporic longing.
